spec: glTF 1.0 (Khronos, 2016): a skin's weights held to the one skinning rule every reader follows: a joint named twice on a vertex merged, weights scaled to sum to 1, and a vertex no joint moves bound to the node that draws it (a joint added to the skin, its inverse bind matrix the identity); skin.skeleton is the joints' common root, the RootNode over both scene roots
